✧ uh.. chests?

⛰️ Mount Horror - A mountain that must not be crossed ⛰️

🎮 Main Gameplay Features 
→ 🌲 Horror mountain trail, checkpoint to the summit 
→ 🔦 Darkness, flashlight, stamina & water need to be managed 
→ 👻 Jump scares and chases: pocong, kunti, and other ghosts 
→ 🙏 Sasajen missions, rituals, and puzzles on the path

🙏 Keep supporting so that this project can grow and become more popular in the future.
